Reilly Financial Advisors Continues to Hold Stake in Starbucks (SBUX); As Home Depot (HD) Shares Declined, Shareholder Alethea Capital Management Decreased Holding by $523,719
May 20, 2018 - By Richard Conner
Reilly Financial Advisors Llc increased its stake in Starbucks Corp (SBUX) by 49.94% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Reilly Financial Advisors Llc bought 6,316 shares as the company’s stock rose 0.28% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 18,964 shares of the restaurants company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.09M, up from 12,648 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Reilly Financial Advisors Llc who had been investing in Starbucks Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $78.88B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.07% or $0.04 during the last trading session, reaching $57.16. About 6.84M shares traded. Starbucks Corporation (NASDAQ:SBUX) has risen 0.40% since May 20, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 11.15% the S&P500.
Alethea Capital Management Llc decreased its stake in Home Depot Inc (HD) by 56.55% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Alethea Capital Management Llc sold 2,771 shares as the company’s stock declined 7.15% with the market. The institutional investor held 2,129 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $404,000, down from 4,900 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Alethea Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Home Depot Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $216.04B market cap company. The stock increased 1.13% or $2.09 during the last trading session, reaching $187.42. About 4.70M shares traded. The Home Depot, Inc. (NYSE:HD) has risen 18.94% since May 20, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.39% the S&P500.
